text: The Upgrade of Seismic Monitoring at Lae Seismic Station involves transitioning from short-period to broadband instrumentation as part of the broader Technical Disaster Risk Reduction (TDRR) program led by Geoscience Australia. This initiative aims to enhance earthquake monitoring and decision-support systems in Papua New Guinea, particularly in Lae, a critical urban and industrial hub. The upgrade supports near-real-time situational awareness, engineering design inputs, and retrofit decisions, contributing to improved earthquake risk management in the region.
